query:
SELECT
                d.id AS "id!: models::Id",
                d.created_at,
                d.updated_at,
                d.detail,
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM draft_specs ds
                    WHERE ds.draft_id = d.id
                      AND ds.catalog_name::text ^@ ANY($3)
                ) AS "num_specs!"
            FROM drafts d
            WHERE d.id = $1 AND d.user_id = $2
